name: Cold waves & winter storms
summary: No top-tier cold or winter-storm warning across a major region on 18 Nov; snow warnings limited to US mountain areas
state: The US National Weather Service in Pendleton issued a winter storm warning on 17 Nov for the east slopes of the Oregon Cascades, with 6 to 12 inches of snow on the crest until 10pm on 18 Nov (KTVZ). In the UK, yellow cold-health alerts cover northern England until 19 Nov, but no top-tier warning is in force. Searches on 18 Nov found no top-tier warning across a major region and no cold-related power or gas outages, so Normal is kept.
for_you: Little wider disruption is expected. People in northern England can follow UKHSA cold-health alert advice and Met Office forecasts for icy roads.
rubric_hit: Normal: no top-tier cold or winter-storm warning across a major region as of 18 Nov

sources.title: KTVZ — Winter Storm Warning issued 17 November by NWS Pendleton OR

why: Severe cold and winter storms kill, cut power and spike gas demand, as in Texas in 2021; they matter most when energy supplies are tight.
drivers: Polar vortex disruption, blocking highs, ENSO, Arctic outbreaks.

rubric.alert: Deadly cold or winter storms with widespread power or gas outages.
rubric.watch: Top-tier cold or winter-storm warnings across a major region, or a cold wave lifting gas demand sharply.
rubric.normal: No major cold wave or winter storm affecting large populations.
